policy_questions.question: The text says five bill status types but lists six (Draft, Issued, Paid, Overdue, Awaiting Payment, Disputed). Which list is right?
The text writes statuses as Overdue, overdue and AWAITING PAYMENT, and the tool description writes AWAITING_PAYMENT. What is the exact stored value of an overdue bill?
The rule on contract end dates compares with the fixed current time in the text (2025-02-25). Does this date stay fixed for every case?

The text says to guide the user to use device tools and to use the make_payment tool, and tools.json lists them as user__ tools of the agent. May the agent call a user__ tool itself, or must the user do it?

The Change Plan steps say to gather available plans and apply the plan, but tools.json has no tool that lists plans or changes the plan of a line. Should the agent transfer these requests, or is a tool missing?
Calculate the price of the new plan: is this the monthly price of the plan, or a difference from the current plan? The text does not define it.
The manual says to escalate to technical support. Does this mean the tool transfer_to_human_agents and the fixed transfer message, or another channel?
Is the maximum of 2GB for one refuel call, or a total for the line per billing cycle? The rule checks one call only.
The text lists reasons for which a line can be suspended. Is this a limit on suspend_line for the agent, so that a suspension the user asks for with another reason must be denied?

May the agent lift a suspension when the user has no overdue bills and the contract has not ended, or a line in Pending Activation? The manual names other reasons not resolvable by the agent but does not define them.

The policy says to transfer if and only if the request cannot be handled; the description of transfer_to_human_agents also allows a transfer when the user explicitly asks for a human agent. Which one decides?
What is enough for try your best and try all the possible ways before a transfer: every check of the matching section of the manual, or less?
For MMS on 2G the text gives examples ("4g_5g_preferred" or "4g_only"). Is any mode that includes 3G, 4G or 5G accepted, or one exact mode? The obligation holds no value until this is answered.
tools.json has write tools that no statement describes for a case, such as disable_roaming, user__set_apn_settings, user__connect_vpn and user__toggle_wifi. May the agent use them, and when?
